seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [chaser,container,target,target,target,target] show mixed outcomes: pixels,tags x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player A1-4 sets cap and moves 4 (blocked by wall/box/chaser/bounds); grabbed box moves rigidly and ignores the wall.
Box state: faced iff idle box at player+cap; A5 toggles faced<->grabbed; border idle4/carried5/faced3/grabbed0, centre 9; seated/filled positional; names by (y,x).
Chaser acts each step after the player: release seated carried box (the hypothesis case: carried+seated tags -> idle; already idle -> no change) > pick up free box touching its left > step 4 toward nearest pickup/empty slot, x first then y.
Wall = period-4 dither masked by layer>0 objects, bbox cropped to visible pixels.
Unconfirmed: cap_down sprite, turning while grabbed, player-chaser collisions, tie-breaks. Stateless; 32/32.
